title: Glowing castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='skyGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2a1a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a2a6a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='castleGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a83a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- castle body -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='42' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='6' fill='#e8b85a'/>

  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='16' height='55' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='16' height='5' fill='#e8b85a'/>
  <!-- left tower crenellations -->
  <rect x='12' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='20' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='27' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='12' y='30' width='20' height='4' fill='#e8b85a'/>

  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='70' y='32' width='16' height='55' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='70' y='32' width='16' height='5' fill='#e8b85a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='76' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='83' y='24' width='5' height='9' fill='#b8791f'/>
  <rect x='68' y='30' width='20' height='4' fill='#e8b85a'/>

  <!-- center top crenellations -->
  <rect x='34' y='38' width='6' height='9' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='6' height='9' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='54' y='38' width='6' height='9' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='62' y='38' width='6' height='9' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='32' y='44' width='38' height='4' fill='#e8b85a'/>

  <!-- glowing windows -->
  <rect x='19' y='42' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <rect x='75' y='42' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <rect x='37' y='55' width='6' height='9' rx='1' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <rect x='57' y='55' width='6' height='9' rx='1' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <rect x='47' y='70' width='6' height='9' rx='1' fill='#fff2b8'/>

  <!-- glowing door -->
  <path d='M44 87 L44 76 Q50 70 56 76 L56 87 Z' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <path d='M44 87 L44 76 Q50 70 56 76 L56 87 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- glow halos -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='46' r='7' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='46' r='7' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='10' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.22'/>
</svg>
